Title: ISO Certification expanded to include more Azure services

Body.Content: Azure has successfully completed its annual ISO audit. In addition to Cloud Services, Storage, Virtual Machines and Virtual Networks, the scope of the audit increased to include SQL Database, Active Directory, Traffic Manager, Web Sites, BizTalk Services, Media Services, Mobile Services, Service Bus, Multi-Factor Authentication, and HDInsight. Visit the Trust Center for a full list.
